name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
estimated_benefit: 000 per year via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT)
eligibility: Provide income support to all landholding farmer families in the country to supplement their financial needs.
documents: An initiative by the Government of India providing small and marginal farmers with up to ₹6
target_occupations: 000 per year as minimum income support in three equal 4-monthly installments.

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship (NMMSS)
estimated_benefit: 000 per annum deposited directly into student bank account
eligibility: Award scholarships to meritorious students of economically weaker sections to arrest drop-out at class VIII.
target_occupations: 000 per annum for students studying in classes IX to XII in State Govt and Govt-aided schools.
target_sectors: Students studying in Class VIII in government or aided schools;Minimum 55% marks in Class VII exam (50% for SC/ST);Parental annual income not exceeding ₹3

name: Ayushman Bharat - PM-JAY
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
target_occupations: Provide free secondary and tertiary care hospitalization to poor and vulnerable families.
target_sectors: World's largest government-funded healthcare assurance scheme offering health cover of up to ₹5 lakh per family per year across empaneled hospitals.
deadline: Households identified under SECC 2011 deprivation criteria;All senior citizens aged 70+;No restriction on family size

name: PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
benefits_summary: Free electricity up to 300 units per month plus capital subsidy up to ₹78
eligibility: Incentivize residential rooftop solar installation to reduce electricity bills and support green energy.
documents: A flagship solar scheme providing direct central subsidy up to ₹78
target_sectors: Must be an Indian citizen;Must possess a residential house with suitable rooftop;Must have an active grid electricity connection
deadline: Aadhaar Card;Recent Electricity Bill;Rooftop Ownership Proof;Bank Passbook / Cancelled Cheque

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY-Gramin)
benefits_summary: Direct financial assistance of ₹1.20 Lakh to ₹1.30 Lakh for pucca house construction
eligibility: Provide a pucca house with basic amenities to all houseless households and households living in kutcha/dilapidated houses.
documents: Financial assistance provided directly to eligible rural families in installments linked to construction milestones.
target_occupations: Houseless families or families living in zero/one/two room kutcha houses;Identified through SECC 2011 & Awaas+ survey;No pucca house owned anywhere in India
target_sectors: Aadhaar Card;MGNREGA Job Card;Bank Account Details;Land / Site Ownership Document

name: Stand-Up India Scheme
benefits_summary: Composite bank loans from ₹10 Lakh to ₹1 Crore for SC/ST and Women entrepreneurs
objective: Facilitate bank loans to SC/ST and women entrepreneurs for greenfield manufacturing
documents: Provides composite bank finance with repayment tenure of up to 7 years with a moratorium of up to 18 months.
target_occupations: SC/ST and/or woman entrepreneurs aged 18+;For non-individual enterprises 51% stake must be held by SC/ST or woman;Borrower must not be in default to any financial institution
target_sectors: Identity Proof;Address Proof;Business DPR / Project Plan;PAN Card;Caste Certificate
